scope: Preserve ten scenarios; state-bound robot planning; immutable baseline and final comparison

events.note: Reported elapsed includes overnight suspended session and is not a performance measurement

events.change: Require initial state, canon, topology and prop policy to match frozen seed
Deep-copy initial state so working-template mutation cannot change baseline

remaining: Generate a new plan and story from the frozen robot request/seed.
Only then compare the new accepted final state; no robot ending has been fabricated.
